deps.title: Settings & Dependencies
deps.themeHint: Pick a colour scheme, or enable the switch below to follow Eagle
deps.followThemeHint: Use Eagle's current appearance; turn off to use the theme selected above
deps.autoAddSourceHint: When enabled, original web URLs are automatically saved to Eagle items
deps.xhsTagsHint: When enabled, Xiaohongshu note topics are written as Eagle tags; turn off to import without any tags
deps.tagsNote: Tags are written into Eagle when an item is imported: Xiaohongshu notes use their topics, other sites use the site identifier. Up to 30 tags per import.
deps.twNameHint: The left column builds the imported item name, the right column builds its annotation; each row's arrows set the order. With nothing selected the name keeps "tweet text - @handle" and the annotation keeps the plain tweet text. Twitter ID means the author numeric ID.
deps.twNameNote: Name: fields joined with " - " in the order you arrange, illegal filename characters replaced, " (1/N)" appended when one tweet yields several files.
deps.twAnNote: Annotation: joined with " - " in the order you arrange, up to 5000 characters; checking any field replaces the plain tweet text, so check "Text" to keep it.
Annotation is joined with " - " in the order you arrange and truncated past 5000 characters. Checking any field replaces the plain tweet text, so check "Tweet text" if you want to keep it.
deps.maxResolutionHint: Limit the maximum video resolution. If not available, automatically falls back to the highest available resolution.
deps.maxFramerateHint: Limit the maximum frame rate. If not available, automatically falls back to the highest available frame rate.
deps.setupRequired: These components are required for first-time use. The main view will open automatically once setup is complete.
deps.ffmpegManaged: Managed by Eagle, no action needed
deps.ffmpegNotFoundHint: Eagle built-in FFmpeg plugin not found. Please click the button below to install it.
deps.ffmpegUnsupported: Eagle official FFmpeg plugin is required for audio/video merging
deps.threadCountHint: Concurrent fragments for HLS/DASH. Not always faster; direct MP4 stays single-connection.
deps.sankakuAuthHint: Paste the accessToken cookie (or JSON from get-cookies / Cookie-Editor) to download login-only posts.
deps.sankakuAuthSaved: Saved. Login-only posts will use this session.
deps.sankakuAuthInvalid: No accessToken found in the pasted text.
deps.twitterAuthHint: Copy auth_token and ct0 from the browser cookies of a logged-in x.com session.
deps.twitterAuthInvalid: Cookie needs both auth_token and ct0
deps.twitterMonitorHint: New likes and bookmarks are pushed to the download queue automatically.
deps.twitterCatchup: Caught up {{count}} new posts since last session
deps.twitterCatchupTruncated: more pending in the next cycle
deps.twitterMonitorNoSource: Select at least one of fetch likes / fetch bookmarks
